# Third-party notices

Xylo adapts the Win32 interop declarations, spring animation integrator, and layered-window rendering approach from [WinIsland](https://github.com/zHeuzy2/WinIsland) by zHeuzy.

The upstream MIT license is preserved in [WinIsland.LICENSE](WinIsland.LICENSE) and copied into build and publish output. Xylo does not include WinIsland's camera, weather, updater, or background services.

SkiaSharp and its Windows native assets are consumed through NuGet under their respective licenses. See [SkiaSharp](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp) for upstream notices.
